title: The Environment Management Act, 2002 (Act No. 5 of 2002)
citation: Act No. 5 of 2002; enacted by the King and Parliament of Swaziland; assented to 13 November 2002
evidence: Section 1 provides: "This Act may be cited as the Environment Management Act, 2002, and shall come into force on the date or dates appointed by the Minister by notice in the Gazette and the Minister may appoint different dates for the coming into operation of different provisions of the Act." No official page states the appointed date; the Act was assented to on 2002-11-13.
notes: Framework environmental enactment of Eswatini, establishing the Eswatini Environment Authority and Swaziland Environment Fund. Published by the Eswatini Environment Authority at https://eea.org.sz/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/EMA-2002.pdf. Legislation in Eswatini is enacted and published in English; no official siSwati translation is published or served. Stored as 2002-11-13-adopted-en.json dated by its assent date.

title: The Environment Assessment Regulations, 2022 (Legal Notice No. 465 of 2022)
citation: Legal Notice No. 465 of 2022, made under Section 33 of the Environment Management Act, 2002; Eswatini Government Gazette Vol. LX, No. 189 of 30 December 2022
evidence: Regulation 1(2): "This Notice shall come into force on the date of publication in the Gazette." Published in Eswatini Government Gazette No. 189 of Friday, 30 December 2022.
notes: Implements Section 33 of the Environment Management Act, 2002 (sz-environment-management-act-2002). The official PDF is a 34-page scanned copy of the Gazette supplement; the record text is uncorrected OCR output of the scanned official PDF. English only; enacted and gazetted in English.

title: The Control of Plastic Bags Regulations, 2021 (Legal Notice No. 155 of 2021)
citation: Legal Notice No. 155 of 2021, made under Section 89 of the Environment Management Act, 2002; Eswatini Government Gazette Vol. LIX, No. 67 of 21 May 2021
evidence: Regulation 1(2): "These Regulations shall come into force on the date of publication in the Gazette." Published in Eswatini Government Gazette No. 67 of Friday, 21 May 2021.
notes: Implements Section 89 of the Environment Management Act, 2002 (sz-environment-management-act-2002) regulating manufacture, commercial distribution and importation of plastic bags. The official PDF is an 8-page scanned copy of the Gazette supplement; the record text is uncorrected OCR output of the scanned official PDF. English only.

title: The Ozone Depleting Substances Regulations, 2003 (Legal Notice No. 14 of 2003)
citation: Legal Notice No. 14 of 2003, made under Section 18 of the Swaziland Environment Authority Act, 1992
evidence: Regulation 1: "The regulations may be cited as the Ozone Depleting Substances Regulations, 2004 and shall come into force on publication in the Gazette." Official PDF carries date of text 1 January 2003 (Legal Notice 14 of 2003); gazette publication date not printed on the document.
notes: Regulates import, handling and phase-out of ozone-depleting substances and controlled products under the Montreal Protocol. Text is digital text extracted directly from the official PDF with pdftotext. Stored as 2003-01-01-adopted-en.json. English only.

title: Fair Trading Act, 2001 (Act No. 5 of 2001)
citation: Act No. 5 of 2001; enacted 2001; commenced 5 November 2001
evidence: Commenced 5 November 2001 per administrative notices; Section 4 prohibits misleading or deceptive conduct in trade and Section 5 prohibits false representations regarding goods and services.
notes: Consumer protection framework in Eswatini covering misleading or deceptive conduct in trade. The Eswatini Competition Commission portal (https://www.compco.co.sz/legislation/) lists legislation in PDF format but requires an email request to info@compco.co.sz and does not expose direct download links. Row SZ-COMPCO-ADOPTED is permission requested; status link only.
